intro: Kentucky runs its elections county by county, through the county clerk and a county board of elections.

id_rule.text: Bring a photo ID. Kentucky accepts a photo ID issued by the U.S. government or the state of Kentucky, a military ID, or a photo ID from a college or from a city or county government in Kentucky.

elections.name: General election
elections.hours: 6:00 am to 6:00 pm, local time (Kentucky has two time zones)
elections.what: Federal, state and local offices, plus any statewide or local measures. Your exact ballot depends on where you live.

dates.label: Last day to register to vote
dates.detail: Register online by 4:00 pm local time, or mail a paper form postmarked by this date. Kentucky's registration books stay closed from Oct. 6 through Nov. 9.

src.label: Kentucky State Board of Elections, 2026 election calendar

dates.label: Online mail ballot request closes
dates.detail: The online request portal closes at 11:59 pm (14 days before Election Day). Voting by mail in Kentucky is limited to voters who meet certain reasons, such as being away from the county or being unable to vote in person because of age, disability, or illness.

src.label: Kentucky State Board of Elections, 2026 election calendar
Kentucky State Board of Elections, absentee voting

dates.label: Excused in-person absentee voting
dates.detail: Voters with an approved reason can vote in person at their county clerk's office on business days from Oct. 21 to Oct. 28. Hours are set by each county.

src.label: Kentucky State Board of Elections, 2026 election calendar
Kentucky State Board of Elections, absentee voting

dates.label: Early voting, no excuse needed
dates.detail: Any registered voter can vote in person at the county clerk's office or another site the county sets up. Each county sets its own sites and hours.

src.label: Kentucky State Board of Elections, 2026 election calendar

dates.label: Election Day
dates.detail: Polls are open 6 am to 6 pm, local time. A mail-in absentee ballot must be received by the county clerk before 6 pm.
